title: Fake News, School, and Politics
summary: Media trust, education, politics, negotiation, and reaching consensus.
whyItMatters: Media, education, and politics require source awareness, careful distinction between evidence and opinion, and the ability to negotiate shared decisions.

mentalModel.title: Pause before sharing
mentalModel.content: Identify the claim, source, evidence, date, and purpose before accepting or forwarding information.

mentalModel.title: Separate verification from agreement
mentalModel.content: A claim can be accurately reported even when people disagree about its interpretation or consequences.

ruleBlocks.title: Check source and origin
ruleBlocks.content: Ask who published the information, when, with what expertise, and whether the original source is available.

ruleBlocks.title: Inspect evidence and corroboration
ruleBlocks.content: Look for data, named witnesses, documents, and independent reporting.

ruleBlocks.title: Recognize manipulation signals
ruleBlocks.content: Notice emotional headlines, false urgency, missing context, edited images, and claims that cannot be checked.

ruleBlocks.title: Treat media literacy as a process
ruleBlocks.content: Practice searching, comparing, citing, correcting, and explaining uncertainty.

sentenceStructure: Report the claim before evaluating it.
Name the source and degree of certainty.
Distinguish missing evidence from proven falsehood.
Correct the record clearly when new information appears.

concepts: evaluate rhetorical framing and source quality

comparisons.summary: Advanced connectors express method, omitted action, alternatives, and apparent reality.
The communication lesson supports correction and negotiated agreement without hiding uncertainty.

examples.de: Der Beitrag nennt keine Quelle für die zentrale Behauptung.
examples.en: The post names no source for its central claim.

examples.de: Das Foto ist echt, wurde aber in einem anderen Zusammenhang aufgenommen.
examples.en: The photo is real but was taken in a different context.

examples.de: Mehrere unabhängige Medien bestätigen dieselben Grundinformationen.
examples.en: Several independent media outlets confirm the same basic information.

examples.de: Schulen können Medienkompetenz fördern, indem Lernende Quellen praktisch überprüfen.
examples.en: Schools can promote media literacy by having learners verify sources in practice.

examples.de: Die Redaktion hat den Fehler erklärt und den Artikel sichtbar korrigiert.
examples.en: The editorial team explained the error and visibly corrected the article.

commonMistakes.wrong: Assume an unfamiliar claim is automatically false.
commonMistakes.correct: Assess source and evidence before deciding.

commonMistakes.wrong: Treat repetition across copied posts as independent confirmation.
commonMistakes.correct: Trace reports back to their original sources.
commonMistakes.reason: Many posts may repeat one unsupported claim.

commonMistakes.wrong: Label every opinion as fake news.
commonMistakes.correct: Distinguish value judgments from checkable factual claims.
commonMistakes.reason: Different statement types require different evaluation.

tips: Open the original source before sharing.
